description: liste des sites Très Haut Débit is a dataset listed in Occitanie open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Occitanie. Liste des sites Très Haut Débit en région Occitanie dans le cadre du groupement de commandes THDOC piloté par la Région Occitanie. Coverage: Occitanie. The portal files it under Attractivité et Innovation. Its keywords are Haut débit, numérique, THD, THDOC. The portal shows 1,101 records. The portal shows 2024-08-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-laregion-fr-portal.
